# arin_irr_aut_num (Data Source)

Read an IRR aut-num object and its routing policy. This is not an ASN registration record.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
# Set ARIN_API_KEY in the environment.
data "arin_irr_aut_num" "example" {
  asn = 64496
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `asn` (Number) ASN as a number without an AS prefix.

### Read-Only

- `as_name` (String) as name returned by ARIN.
- `as_number` (String) as number returned by ARIN.
- `creation_date` (String) creation date returned by ARIN.
- `default_policy` (List of String) Ordered lines of default policy.
- `description` (List of String) Ordered lines of description.
- `export_policy` (List of String) Ordered lines of export policy.
- `import_policy` (List of String) Ordered lines of import policy.
- `last_modified_date` (String) last modified date returned by ARIN.
- `mp_default_policy` (List of String) Ordered lines of mp default policy.
- `mp_export_policy` (List of String) Ordered lines of mp export policy.
- `mp_import_policy` (List of String) Ordered lines of mp import policy.
- `org_handle` (String) org handle returned by ARIN.
- `poc_links` (Attributes List) poc links returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--poc_links))
- `remarks` (List of String) Ordered lines of remarks.
- `source` (String) source returned by ARIN.
